# meshoptimizer

The encoder and decoder modules come from the
[meshoptimizer 1.3.0 npm release](https://www.npmjs.com/package/meshoptimizer/v/1.3.0)
(`meshoptimizer-1.3.0.tgz` SHA-1 `e018628fede1763896ead324b09feecab1df71ff`).
The encoder filename uses `.mjs` for use as a Node ES module. Both files
include the upstream WebAssembly binaries. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).
